entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 汉、闽、官三栏皆空，西语词头「p. qs.」为缩略且词尾难辨，无从定夺。

entries.en: to take a wife; (of a man) to marry
to marry (of a woman); to be given in marriage
matchmaker; the arranging of a marriage
entries.notes: M 栏「m.」后带 [疑]，L 词尾残缺；官话栏「mūey」与「媒」相应。

entries.zh: 冰人；媒人（「冰人」为媒人的古称）
entries.en: matchmaker (bingren, "ice person", a classical term for a go-between)

entries.zh: 牵手；结为夫妻（闽南语「牵手」指成婚、配偶）
entries.en: to join hands in marriage; to wed (Hokkien khan-chhiu, "to lead by the hand")
to take a wife; (of a man) to marry a woman
entries.notes: 汉栏原字 [疑:某/山]，官话栏「mon」可证为「某」，故按「娶某」释义。

entries.zh: 娶亲；男子成婚（迎娶新妇）
entries.en: to take a bride; to fetch the bride (wedding)

entries.zh: 娶媳妇；娶新妇（男子娶妻）
entries.en: to take a wife; to bring home a bride
entries.notes: 官话栏 [疑:ie/ke]，M 栏「hẽ sin pu」即「娶新妇」，义可定。

entries.en: to marry off (a daughter); to give a daughter out in marriage
entries.notes: M、R 两栏于「出」字均有 [疑]（chun/chut、chut/chuit）。

entries.en: to take a husband (of a woman); to marry
entries.notes: 汉栏「嫁婿」义明，惟 M「Lay」、R「by」与「婿」对音不合，第二音节存疑。

entries.zh: 暗相许；私下许婚（不告父母的私订终身）
entries.en: to pledge marriage in secret; a clandestine betrothal
entries.notes: 西语词头 [疑:aespandidas/aescondidas]，取「a escondidas（暗中）」与汉栏「暗相许」相合；官话栏 [残] 且带 T99。

entries.en: to dote on one's wife; to be intimate with one's wife
entries.notes: 西语词头「a la ueja」疑即「a la vieja（娶老妇）」，与汉、闽栏「昵妻」不合，义暂从汉栏。

entries.en: to marry off one's daughter; (of parents) to give a daughter in marriage
entries.notes: 官话栏 [残]，然西语「casar los padres a su hija」与汉栏「嫁女子」互证。

entries.zh: 进赘；入赘（女婿入居女家）
entries.en: uxorilocal marriage; to marry into the bride's family
for a widow to remarry
for a widower to remarry; to take another wife
entries.notes: L「biedos」[疑]，汉栏「再」[疑:再/冉]；官话栏「chay chy」可证「再娶」。

entries.en: to take a second wife; to remarry after a wife's death

entries.zh: 娶后姐仔；男子二婚再娶
entries.en: for a man to marry a second time; to take a later wife

entries.zh: 同襟；两男娶姐妹（结为连襟）
entries.en: for two men to marry two sisters; to become co-brothers-in-law
to complete the marriage; to consummate the wedding
to become kin by marriage; to join in marriage
entries.notes: L 末词 [疑:Juntarse/Juritarse]，官话栏「gan」与「亲」对音不合，第二音节存疑。
